fit_population: All 3329 observed CORDIS records, including evaluation inputs; transductive unsupervised fit
label_use: None in normalization, retrieval, fitting, threshold or prior choice. Source labels only determined split grouping during separate curation.

lexical_decisions.top1: Always retain separate top-ranked retrieval result

native: Prepared separately; this run does not score native affiliation sets or fit a multi-target policy
normalization: Unicode NFKD, remove combining marks, casefold, retain Unicode word characters; preserve non-Latin scripts
population: CORDIS structured organization/city/country against all 108476 ROR v1.41 rows, including inactive and withdrawn records

retrieval.exact_alias: Complete normalized name/alias/acronym/multilingual-label equality; union all owners before reranking

splink.calibration: Unestablished; fixed rules and descriptive sensitivity only
splink.capacity: At most one target per CORDIS query, many queries may map to same registry entity; no one-to-one assignment
splink.decision: Top posterior >=0.99 and no second candidate >=0.5 -> linked; top<0.1 -> nil; otherwise review
splink.main_prior_rule: Recall 0.8 if implied matches <=3329, otherwise 0.95 then 1.0; choice uses observed anchor count only
splink.sensitivity: Fit at main feasible prior once; recompute posterior sensitivity with fixed learned likelihood ratios for every feasible prior scenario
splink.sparse_levels: Record estimated/missing/default/zero probabilities; use explicit effective Splink values, never silently replace a failed fit
splink.strict_prior_rule: One unique complete-registry exact alias candidate with agreeing nonmissing country, one anchor per query
